overview: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh is a 1977 American animated musical fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Productions, based on characters appearing in the Winnie-the-Pooh stories by A. A. Milne and E. H. Shepard. Directed by Wolfgang Reitherman and John Lounsbery, it is a compilation consisting of three Winnie the Pooh short films: Winnie the Pooh and the Honey Tree (1966), Winnie the Pooh and the Blustery Day (1968), and Winnie the Pooh and Tigger Too (1974). It was first released on a double bill with The Littlest Horse Thieves on March 11, 1977.
